description: Defines data structures and functions related to network interface configuration and allocation within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, including 'IfaceData', 'IfaceConfig', and functions for default configuration and resource allocation.

classes.name: IfaceData
classes.description: Holds information about a network interface, including its name, session ID, and resource ID.

classes.name: IfaceConfig
classes.description: Contains configuration for various network interfaces such as mobile tap, bridged wireless tap, non-bridged wireless tap, and ethernet tap.

methods.name: DefaultNetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns a default network interface configuration based on the number of interfaces specified.

methods.name: AllocateNetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Attempts to acquire network interfaces from the resource allocator daemon, returning an optional configuration.
